about_sub: We help devotees get poojas and chadhava performed at famous temples, in their own name, wherever they live.
about_story_p1: Many families cannot travel to a temple for an important pooja. Some live far away, some cannot take leave, some have elders who cannot travel. We started Narayan Kripa so that distance does not stop anyone from doing a pooja the right way.
about_story_p2: We work with pandits at partner temples. You book online, give the names and gotra for the sankalp, and pandit ji performs the pooja at the temple on the chosen day. We send you the video so you can see it was done in your name.
about_how_t: How we make sure it is done right
about_how_1_d: Poojas are performed at the temple by experienced pandits who know its traditions.
about_how_2_d: Every name and gotra you give is recited. Not sure of the gotra? Kashyap is used, as the shastras suggest.
about_how_3_d: You receive the video of your pooja on WhatsApp within 24 to 48 hours.
about_how_4_d: If you add a prasad box, we courier it to any address in India.
about_contact_d: Our team answers on WhatsApp and phone, Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM.
